acceptanceCriteria: The refusal has an owned error code naming the limit and the observed count.
A focused test exceeds the limit and asserts the typed code; it fails before the fix.
body: Residual from lane bf-1022q (PR beamfall/corvint#1547, seal 52f25c48d). When flow generation exceeds 256 flows, generate.go:254 returns an untyped internal-error instead of a typed, documented refusal naming the limit.
title: flowdocs: the 256-flow limit refusal surfaces as an untyped internal-error
